messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads up — Pilot Spark cohort goes live next Tue. Need final enroll list + kickoff comms by Friday EOD.
Priya (CS): Thanks Maya — what’s the exact cutoff time and timezone?
Maya (CS): Fri 11:59pm PT. Send roster + primary POC emails.
Sam (Enablement): I can own the kickoff slide deck and demo flow. Anyone have a short customer story we should highlight? :tada:
Nadia (Customer Success Manager): I have a quote from AlderHealth (pilot) about 'fast onboarding' — will DM it. Also we should record the enablement for on-demand.
Jon (Solutions Eng): On integration side: Verified tokens + env var rotation checklist ready. We should also instrument latency on auth and generate endpoints. If latency >200ms on auth flows we should flag.
Maya (CS): Good call. Priya can you own the renewal-risk playbook item if we see perf regressions?
Priya (CS): Yep — I’ll prepare a short cadence for customers at risk and coordinate with sales ops.
redwood-bot: Calendar event created: "Spark Pilot Kickoff — Tue 09:00 PT" (meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/abc123)
Maya (CS): Also want a 1-week feedback window post-kickoff with two quick touchpoints (survey + 15m follow-up). Use this short survey snippet: https://tiny.red/rdw-spark-survey
Sam (Enablement): For the demo I’ll include a quick verification script so customers can validate throughput locally.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Pasting the minimal checklist we’ll share with customers:
```
1) Add API key to env: REDWOOD_API_KEY
2) Run sample request: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
3) Confirm response time < 300ms for 1k token payloads
4) If >300ms, open support ticket with trace id
```
Priya (CS): Should we offer an incentive for survey completion? $25 gift card seems to boost response.
Nadia (Customer Success Manager): Agree — offer gift card for first 20 respondents. Call it out in the kickoff. :money_with_wings:
Maya (CS): Nice. Assigning owners: Enrollment roster (Priya), Kickoff slides + demo (Sam), Integration checklist & traces (Jon), Follow-up survey & outreach (Nadia). I’ll facilitate exec intro emails.
Sam (Enablement): I’ll add a 5-min segment on cost/usage best practices (batching + cache tips).
Jon (Solutions Eng): I’ll add a short trace snippet customers can paste to get a request id to send to support.
Priya (CS): Uploading roster to the shared drive now: https://drive.redwood.ai/spark/pilot/roster.csv
Maya (CS): Reminder: please add slack handles to the roster so we can do quick DMs during rollout.
Nadia (Customer Success Manager): Will do. Also scheduling a 15m "early signal" check on Thu next week for any immediate issues.
Maya (CS): Final ask — any red flags before Friday? If you see integration blockers, flag in #customer-support and ping me. :eyes:
Jon (Solutions Eng): No blockers from infra. Will validate load tests by tomorrow EOD and post results here.
Priya (CS): Got it. I’ll finalize emails and send the kickoff template by EOD Friday.
Sam (Enablement): Slide draft ETA: tomorrow noon.
Maya (CS): Great team — thanks. Let’s keep updates short in this thread so we have a single source of truth.
Priya (CS): +1
Nadia (Customer Success Manager): +1 :rocket:
